usdRate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026), interbank exchange rate end-September 2026
usdRate.note: ZiG26.80 per US dollar at end-September 2026 (Q3 average 26.70; World Bank 2025 average 26.60). Most deposits, prices and wages in Zimbabwe are in US dollars alongside the ZiG.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026) (ZIMSTAT ZiG CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Annual ZiG CPI inflation 3.7% in September 2026, up from 2.9% in August, the lowest since 1980. The Monetary Policy Committee expects it to end 2026 below 7%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: SADC 3-7% inflation benchmark cited by the Reserve Bank (Q3 2026 snapshot); history of currency collapses (World Bank CPI inflation 104.7% in 2022)
inflation_projection.note: ZiG inflation is low in 2026, but the ZiG was devalued in September 2024 and earlier Zimbabwean currencies collapsed, so 9% (2 points above the top of the 3-7% band) is used for long-range ZiG plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Resolutions of the Monetary Policy Committee meeting held on 28 September 2026
policy_rate.note: Cut from 30% to 27.5% with immediate effect, a total cut of 7.5 points since June 2026 (it was 35% before). Minimum savings and time deposit rates were left unchanged.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
savings_account_rate.note: Minimum savings deposit rate set by the Reserve Bank: ZiG 4.35% (US dollar deposits 2.15%); banks may pay more, but no average actual rate is published.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Minimum time deposit rate set by the Reserve Bank: ZiG 7.18% (US dollar 4.41%), maintained by the MPC on 28 September 2026; no published average by term.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Same Reserve Bank minimum time deposit rate (ZiG 7.18%, US dollar 4.41%); no separate 1-year average is published.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found in Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Zimbabwe
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 6.24% for 2025; the Reserve Bank's statistics pages could not be read (bot check).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No regular treasury bill auction yield was found; the Reserve Bank's ZiG-Denominated Term Deposit Facility pays 8% (30 days) and 11% (90 days) but is taken up mainly by banks and corporates (Q3 2026 snapshot).

tbond_5y_rate.note: No market yield for a 5-year government bond was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No market yield for a 10-year government bond was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding tax rate on bank interest could not be read from ZIMRA's tax-rates page; ZIMRA does state that persons aged 55 or more get an annual exemption on interest from deposits with financial institutions.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Protection Corporation, what is deposit protection (cover limit)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: ZiG deposits are covered up to the ZiG equivalent of US$3,000 per deposit class per bank (US$2,000 at deposit-taking microfinance institutions); US$3,000 x ZiG26.7965 (end-September 2026 interbank rate) = about ZiG80,390.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found; the Reserve Bank caps banks' all-inclusive on-lending rate under the Targeted Finance Facility at 22.5%, which is not a card rate.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe Q3 2026 snapshot; ZiG minimum time deposit rate 7.18%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: local shares lose value in real terms, as they repeatedly did in earlier currency crises.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe Q3 2026 snapshot (ZiG minimum time deposit rate 7.18%)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3 points above the ZiG time deposit floor, below the 4-point cap, because the local index has no meaningful 10-year record in today's currency (the ZiG only began in April 2024).

equity_return_high.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe Q3 2026 snapshot
equity_return_high.note: High case: a strong decade for local shares or a global index fund in ZiG terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate, Zimbabwe (PA.NUS.FCRF); RBZ interbank rate ZiG26.80 per US dollar (September 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stable ZiG.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate, Zimbabwe (PA.NUS.FCRF); RBZ Q3 2026 snapshot
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus about 5% a year of ZiG depreciation (inflation differential with the US dollar).

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate, Zimbabwe (PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and another sharp ZiG devaluation like September 2024.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ZiG savings accounts at about the 4.35% minimum.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: ZiG time deposits at about the 7.18% minimum, less some withholding tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: ZiG term deposit facility bills (11% for 90 days) for savers with access, after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Insurance and Pensions Commission (IPEC) publishes no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per ZiG 1,000 of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Zimbabwe was found from an official or international source.

health_premium_table.note: No published medical aid premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Zimbabwe
oop_health_share.note: 10.6% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.note: No health price index by division could be read, so private medical costs, which are largely priced in US dollars, are assumed to rise 1 point faster than the 9% ZiG inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index by division could be read, so school fees are assumed to rise with the 9% ZiG inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Zimbabwe

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio. 6.34 for 2025 (World Bank; populationpyramid.net also shows 6.3), 5.3 for 2040 and 9.6 for 2065 (populationpyramid.net/zimbabwe/2065/). The ratio rises to 2040 because the working-age population grows faster than the 65+ population.

retirement_age_default.note: The NSSA Pensions and Other Benefits Scheme sets the pension age for private-sector workers, but its rules could not be read: the NSSA website and the law repositories (ZimLII, Veritas, ILO NATLEX) blocked access on 31 October 2026.

retirement_age_government.note: The public service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source that could be read.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: ZiG savings accounts at about the 4.35% minimum.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: ZiG time deposits at about the 7.18% minimum less withholding tax on interest; not above the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in ZiG term deposit facility bills (8-11%) after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about ZiG deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026); equity base 10%; gold base 9%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of ZiG deposits, equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, Snapshot on monetary, currency, price and financial developments, Q3 2026 (key rates as at 30 September 2026); equity high 16%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No universal non-contributory old-age pension was found; support for poor older people comes through poverty-targeted programmes of the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare, whose current amounts could not be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No universal non-contributory old-age pension with a fixed eligibility age was found.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity could be confirmed: the Labour Act text could not be read from an official source (law repositories blocked access on 31 October 2026).

public_pension_scheme.note: The NSSA Pensions and Other Benefits Scheme (compulsory for employees) exists, but its current rules could not be read: the NSSA website and law repositories blocked access on 31 October 2026.

savings_account.note: Offered in ZiG and US dollars; the Reserve Bank sets minimum rates.

fdr_3m.note: Offered in ZiG and US dollars; the Reserve Bank sets a minimum time deposit rate.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No regular retail treasury bill auction was found; the Reserve Bank's ZiG-Denominated Term Deposit Facility (30 and 90 days) is taken up mainly by banks and corporates.

tbond_5y.note: No traded government bond market for individuals was found.

tbond_10y.note: No traded government bond market for individuals was found.

equity_fund.note: Supervised by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe.

gold.localNameEn: Gold coins issued by the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe
gold.note: The Reserve Bank introduced Mosi-oa-Tunya gold coins for public sale in 2022; their 2026 availability could not be checked (RBZ site behind a bot check). Gold also backs the ZiG.

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Authority (NSSA), Pensions and Other Benefits Scheme
pensionScheme.note: Site behind a bot check on 31 October 2026.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Child Care (public health facilities)
publicHealthCover.note: No national health insurance scheme; site did not respond on 31 October 2026.
